models_evaluated: commercial chest X-ray AI triage tool for expedited same-day CT chest

links.outcome: Staff reliance on and disappointment about withdrawn AI triage tool after decommissioning
links.effect: Among reporting staff, 40% (2/5) were disappointed to no longer use the tool and 20% (1/5) reported reliance; 70.0% still believed AI improved patient care; 35% recalled logistical issues.
links.quote: Among reporting staff, 40% (2/5) were disappointed to no longer use the tool, while 20% (1/5) reported reliance on it.

links.outcome: Staff perceptions of workflow, patient care and emotional impact after AI decommissioning
links.effect: Mixed responses: relief at reduced workflow disruption and emotional burden alongside regret over lost patient benefit; comfort with AI on own imaging fell to 25.6% from 31.1%, 48.3%, 47.2%.
links.quote: Decommissioning generated mixed responses, combining operational relief with perceived loss of clinical benefit.

screen.reason: Empirical survey of radiology staff investigating the impact and staff perceptions of decommissioning a real-world deployed CXR AI triage tool.
